name: r-plumber-api
title: R Plumber API
blurb: Plumber JSON service in R: annotated routes, a pure counting function with a base-R test harness, and a live http contract check
default_description: An R HTTP service built with plumber.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: Rscript -e 'if (!requireNamespace("plumber", quietly = TRUE)) { message("plumber is not installed: sudo apt-get install -y r-cran-plumber, or install.packages(\"plumber\")"); quit(status = 1) }; cat("plumber", as.character(packageVersion("plumber")), "\n")'

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5423/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'port 5423 is already answering - stop that process before running this step'; exit 1; fi; PORT=5423 Rscript bin/serve.R > .plumber.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ready=1; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl --max-time 2 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5423/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; kill -0 $srv 2>/dev/null || { cat .plumber.log; echo 'the server exited before it answered'; exit 1; }; if [ $ready -ne 0 ]; then cat .plumber.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; health=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:5423/health); stats=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 'http://127.0.0.1:5423/stats?text=hello%20world%0A'); posted=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"text":"a b
c
"}' http://127.0.0.1:5423/stats); missing=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5423/stats); broken=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary 'nope' http://127.0.0.1:5423/stats); gone=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5423/nope); wrong=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w '%{http_code}' -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:5423/health); kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null || true; cat .plumber.log; printf 'get=%s
post=%s
missing=%s broken=%s gone=%s wrong=%s
' "$stats" "$posted" "$missing" "$broken" "$gone" "$wrong"; test "$health" = '{"status":"ok"}' && printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"lines":1' && printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"bytes":12' && printf '%s' "$posted" | grep -q '"words":3' && test "$missing" = 422 && test "$broken" = 422 && test "$gone" = 404 && test "$wrong" = 405
